rows.name: Goldcot
rows.remarks: Strong, vigorous, spreading tree. Medium-size, medium-firm fruit; self-fruitful

rows.name: Moongold
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, spreading tree. Medium-size fruit; self-unfruitful, pollinate with Sungold

rows.name: Sungold
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree. Large fruit; self-unfruitful, pollinate with Moongold

rows.name: Moorpark
rows.remarks: Vigorous tree. Large fruit; self-fruitful

rows.name: Northstar
rows.remarks: Natural dwarf, spreading tree. Red skin, red flesh fruit

rows.name: Meteor
rows.remarks: Semi-dwarf, upright tree. Red skin, yellow flesh fruit

rows.name: Montmorency
rows.remarks: Vigorous, spreading tree. Red skin, yellow flesh fruit

rows.name: Mesabi
rows.remarks: Sweet cherry by sour cherry hybrid. Sweet red flesh. Ten to fourteen foot pyramidal tree when unpruned

rows.name: Gold
rows.remarks: Vigorous, semi-upright tree; hardiest cultivar. Yellow fruit

rows.name: Black Gold
rows.remarks: Vigorous, semi-upright tree; medium-large fruit. Self-fertile, will pollinate Gold

rows.name: Hedelfingen
rows.remarks: Vigorous tree. Large, red, crack resistant fruit

rows.name: Kristin
rows.remarks: Vigorous tree. Large, purplish-black fruit

rows.name: Rainier
rows.remarks: Vigorous, semi-spreading tree. Large, red-blushed yellow fruit

rows.name: Royal Ann
rows.remarks: Also known as Napoleon. Vigorous, semi-spreading tree. Red-blushed yellow fruit

rows.name: Sam
rows.remarks: Vigorous tree. Large, dark red fruit

rows.name: Van
rows.remarks: Vigorous, upright tree. Crack resistant, red fruit

rows.name: Polly
rows.remarks: Hardy white-fleshed cultivar; clingstone

rows.name: Reliance
rows.remarks: Hardiest yellow-fleshed cultivar; freestone

rows.name: Summercrisp
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree; fire blight resistant. Large fruit; should be consumed while firm and crisp

rows.name: Harrow Delight
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, spreading tree; fire blight resistant. Medium-size fruit

rows.name: Moonglow
rows.remarks: Vigorous, very upright tree; fire blight resistant. Large fruit

rows.name: Ambrosia
rows.remarks: New cultivar; fire blight resistant. Large fruit

rows.name: Bartlett
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree; fire blight susceptible. Large, excellent-quality fruit. Does not pollinate Seckel

rows.name: Delicious
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree; fire blight resistant. Large fruit. Apparently identical to Maxine

rows.name: Honey Sweet
rows.remarks: Vigorous, spreading tree; fire blight moderately resistant. Medium-large fruit

rows.name: Maxine
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree; fire blight resistant. Large fruit. Apparently identical to Delicious

rows.name: Douglas
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree; fire blight moderately resistant. Medium-large fruit

rows.name: Luscious
rows.remarks: Vigorous, hardy tree; fire blight moderately resistant. Medium-size fruit

rows.name: Patten
rows.remarks: Vigorous, upright tree; fire blight moderately resistant. Large fruit

rows.name: Seckel
rows.remarks: Small-fruited European pear listed by Iowa State PM453

rows.name: Kieffer
rows.remarks: Very vigorous, semi-upright tree; hardy; fire blight moderately resistant. Small fruit. Does not pollinate Bartlett

rows.name: Hosui
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree; fire blight moderately resistant. Early fall frost is a risk in northern Iowa

rows.name: Shinseiki
rows.remarks: Trial only

rows.name: 20th Century
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, willowy tree; very fire blight susceptible. Large, round fruit

rows.name: Chojuro
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, spreading tree; very fire blight susceptible. Medium-size, round fruit

rows.name: Mount Royal
rows.remarks: Vigorous, semi-spreading tree. Medium-small, roundish fruit; blue-black skin, greenish-yellow flesh, clingstone

rows.name: Blue Ribbon
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, semi-upright tree. Medium-size, oblong fruit; blue-red skin, freestone

rows.name: Green Gage
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, semi-spreading tree. Small, roundish-oval fruit; green skin, amber flesh, semi-clingstone

rows.name: Stanley
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, upright tree. Large, oblong fruit; dark blue skin, greenish-yellow flesh, semi-freestone

rows.name: Damson
rows.remarks: Vigorous, semi-upright tree. Small, oval fruit; blue skin, yellow flesh, clingstone

rows.name: Italian
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, semi-upright tree. Medium-size, oblong fruit; dark purple skin, greenish-yellow flesh, freestone. Can be dried

rows.name: Underwood
rows.category: Japanese-American hybrid plum cultivars for Iowa
rows.remarks: Vigorous, spreading tree. Large, conic fruit; dull-red skin, golden-yellow flesh, clingstone

rows.name: Toka
rows.category: Japanese-American hybrid plum cultivars for Iowa
rows.remarks: Medium-vigor, semi-spreading tree. Small, conic fruit; red skin, yellow flesh. Excellent pollinator

rows.name: Alderman
rows.category: Japanese-American hybrid plum cultivars for Iowa
rows.remarks: Vigorous, spreading tree. Large, conic fruit; burgundy-red skin, yellow flesh, clingstone

rows.name: Pipestone
rows.category: Japanese-American hybrid plum cultivars for Iowa
rows.remarks: Vigorous tree. Large, conic fruit; red skin, amber flesh, clingstone

rows.name: Superior
rows.category: Japanese-American hybrid plum cultivars for Iowa
rows.remarks: Vigorous, semi-spreading tree. Large, conic fruit; red skin, yellow flesh, clingstone
